name: factwright-sync
description: Factwright’s sync server, ready to deploy to your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sign-ins. Any long random text, such as what `openssl rand -base64 32` prints.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Your GitHub OAuth app’s client ID, for signing in with GitHub.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your GitHub OAuth app’s client secret.

ALLOWED_GITHUB_USERS.description: Your GitHub user name, such as `octocat`: only the accounts named here can sign in. To let in someone else, add their user name after a comma. Left empty, anyone with GitHub can.
